title: Local decision connected with mathematical representation
scenario: A learner encounters a real-life situation where mathematical representation and reasoning and patterns pull the decision in different directions. The learner must use evidence and reasoning rather than guesswork.
tasks: Identify the decision to be made.

title: Transfer case: estimation and checking
scenario: A new situation resembles an idea from 'Finding the Unknown' but includes a different condition. Learners must decide whether the chapter concept still applies.
tasks: Decide what transfers and what does not.
